summary: Finalized invoice shows unexpected negative line after multi-model batch with negotiated per-model override
description:
Issue summary:
Customer BrightMind Analytics reports a negative invoice line (-$1,124.35) on the finalized invoice for billing period 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28. The negative line appears tied to a multi-model batch job that used two models with negotiated per-model overrides plus a month-end promotional credit. The customer expected per-model negotiated rates to apply and a prorated promotional credit to reduce the invoice total; they did not expect a standalone negative line item on the finalized invoice.

Impact:
- Customer-facing: billing team at BrightMind sees an unexplained negative line and requested immediate clarification before autopay.
- Financial: final invoice total differs from console estimate by -$1,124.35. Customer has paused autopay pending explanation.

Environment:
- Production (us-east primary, eu-west fallback)
- Customer account: org-id: org_brightmind_94
- Job: nightly multi-model batch (batch id: bm-2026-02-26-373) that invoked both redwood/open-3b-quant and redwood/optim-7b across two regions for redundancy

Steps to reproduce (customer):
1) Run same nightly multi-model batch with same model pins and routing policy (primary us-east, fallback eu-west).
2) Check Console -> Billing Estimate during/after run.
3) Wait until postback reconciler processes usage window and final invoice generation completes.

Attached logs/ids (from customer):
- Invoice id: INV-2026-02-94-BM
- Negative line id: INV-2026-02-94-BM-LN-07
- Usage postbacks: pb-89124, pb-89125, pb-89130 (staging->prod replay noted)
- Batch job id: bm-2026-02-26-373
- Slack thread: #support-brightmind (https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C07BRIGHT/FF12345678)
comments: 2026-03-10 - Aisha Kapoor (Support): Escalated to billing triage. Customer paused autopay and requested explanation and provisional credit if necessary.

2026-03-10 - Liam Chen (Billing): Acknowledged. Investigating whether negotiated per-model overrides and org-level promo credit interacted incorrectly with regional smoothing. Pulling invoice lines and postback timeline.

2026-03-11 - SRE (Mina Ortega): Noted there was a postback replay from a decommissioned staging proxy (pb-89130) at 02:12 UTC on 2026-02-27. That replay may have been deduplicated at estimate-time but reconciled in final run, causing a corrective offset. Adding to investigation.
2026-03-12 - Aisha Kapoor (Support): Customer requests an ETA for provisional adjustment. Also asks for a short explanation they can share with finance (one-paragraph).
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Promotional org-level credit applied after reserved-rate reconciliation and smoothing produced a negative line to preserve per-line accounting semantics.

Hypothesis 2: Postback replay (pb-89130) from staging proxy was initially filtered in console estimates but applied during final invoice reconciler; reconciler applied negotiated per-model override to the original usage, then applied org-level promo credit separately, resulting in double-application for the same usage volume across two line items, netting a negative line.
Data pulled: invoice lines export, postback timeline (pb-89124..pb-89130), per-model rate override table for org_brightmind_94, promo-credit allocation log (promo-2026-feb-1).

Observed: per-model override correctly listed at time of estimate. Promo credit was queued for prorated application on 2026-02-28 23:59 UTC. Postback replay was ingested 2026-02-27 02:12 UTC which is before promo allocation time; however reconciler reordering during smoothing window applied credits after dedup step causing mis-ordered adjustments.

Preliminary conclusion: ordering bug in final reconciler where credit application happens after per-line reserved-rate reconciliation and dedup offset application. The implemention wrote a negative balancing line to keep total sums accurate when credits exceed a specific line's post-dedup delta, instead of redistributing proportionately across lines.
Risk: Other enterprise customers using per-model negotiated rates plus org-level promos and run multi-region multi-model batches at month-end may see similar negative lines or misattributed credits.
next_steps: (Liam) Confirm exact reconciler code path that produces negative balancing lines and capture commit/PR that last modified ordering (target: 2026-03-13 EOD).
(SRE) Correlate pb-89130 ingestion event and reconciler run timestamps; validate whether dedup filter was applied during estimate vs final run (target: 2026-03-12 noon).
(Billing) Draft one-paragraph explainer for customer finance explaining negative line origin and confirm provisional credit policy (target: 2026-03-12 afternoon).
(Support) Offer provisional hold on autopay and an interim credit if we cannot produce resolution within 48 hours. Notify BrightMind contact: finance@brightmind.ai (contact: Julia Park).

Engineering is working on a fix; timeline for code change and rollback strategy expected by 2026-03-15. We will propose a provisional credit to avoid autopay disruption. - Liam
